contract.selection: Train physical-center labels only. Require >=8 dictionary draws, >=12 panel patches, >=3 dataset-qualified subjects each with >=2 patches, in >=min(2,train dataset count) datasets. EEG rank by center fraction minus occupancy-weighted fit mean (>=0.05 and TRAIN member median above fit mean); Hb rank by smaller absolute center OLS slope (>=0.01 scaled X/s; both signs match on >=60% TRAIN members). Ties: lowest ID. Never substitute a better validating word.
contract.distribution: fit_n counts dictionary draws, not different patches/people. direct_q and other _q fields: unweighted patch [Q25,median,Q75], null if undefined. by_dataset positions are patch counts. Only actual panel support, never a population estimate.
contract.alpha: H1: alpha word > other IDs for same-patch narrow peak rate. Per 2s: demean, Hann, one-sided 0.5-Hz grid, smooth power [1,2,1]/4. Linear fit in dB vs log(f) to four flank medians at 4–5.5,6–7.5,14.5–17,17.5–21 Hz (relative -120 dB floor). A local max centered in [8,13) must be >=6 dB above local fitted background and drop >=3 dB on EACH side within 1.5 Hz. Excess is max residual in band, not simply alpha fraction. Constant X has no spectrum.
contract.high: 45–100 includes 111/200 non-DC bins; even flat noise can allocate ~55% of non-DC energy here (Nyquist single). On unsmoothed Hann PSD require >=5% AC power there. 50/60 line-like: +/-1 Hz has >=25% high-band power and peak >4x respective +/-2–4 Hz flank median. Diffuse-like: neither line, combined neighborhoods <=20%, inverse spectral concentration >=20 effective bins. Other/mixed and little high power are not labelled broad. Line-like is not proof of mains; diffuse is not proof of EMG or a brain rhythm.
contract.hb: H2: opposed vs common OLS word > for next-patch robust opposed fraction, at similar current signed levels. Within each color, medians of samples [2:7],[8:12],[13:18] must step twice in same direction, each step >max(0.01 training-position-scaled X,1.4826*MAD of adjacent increments on [2:18]). Both colors required; unresolved/flat counts as not opposed. Same-patch interior classes test endpoint sensitivity but are not independent of construction. Next-patch label has disjoint samples within exact KEYS, patch+1<=14; adjacent preprocessed Hb is autocorrelated, not an independent subject or proof of neural activation.
contract.matching: Exact dataset, subject and named position; bins floor(v/width+0.5). EEG: rectangular router alpha width 0.05 and log(linear AC RMS) width log(1.25), zeros separate. Hb: both current signed levels width 0.25 G0-scaled X. Within common cells weight both rates by min(n_target_evaluable,n_reference_evaluable); fractional matched_*_hits are sums of weight x cell rate. Gaps are weighted absolute cell-mean differences in binning variables. Equal qualified people per dataset, then equal represented datasets. No control is borrowed across subjects or sites; other-ID rate only refers to these shared strata.
contract.support_gate: Qualified person has >=2 pair mass and >=50% of ALL their target patches (incl missing spectrum/successor). Primary requires >=3 such people in >=min(2,validation dataset count) datasets, and >=50% target mass AND target people covered in each dataset with targets. Raw/shared counts include failures. If insufficient, primary rates/delta are null: overlap_only is descriptive and cannot rescue naming. No extrapolation to absent sites/datasets.
contract.inference: Direction is a falsifiable descriptive validation prediction: delta=target-reference <=0 is not the predicted direction. CI when defined: stratified paired subject percentile bootstrap (2000, seed=1731), datasets fixed; withheld with <2 qualified people per contributing dataset. No tuning, multiplicity correction, statistical confirmation, artifact attribution or cross-modal coupling claim.
